tubend-hp.name: HP 10 – HP 100 NC hydraulic horizontal presses, 11 – 110 US ton
tubend-hp.models_label: HP 10 · HP 20 · HP 40 · HP 60 · HP 80 · HP 100 · 6 models
tubend-hp.summary: A horizontal press brake lays the press on its side: a hydraulic ram pushes the tool across a heavy steel table at bench height, so flat bar, angle, pipe, solid bar and busbar are bent, punched, sheared or straightened with the part lying flat in front of the operator. Tubend's HP series runs from the 11-ton HP 10 for 5-7/8″ × 1/4″ flat bar to the 110-ton HP 100 for 11-13/16″ × 15/16″, every model with an NC touch-screen on a control stand — manual, automatic and recipe modes — a foot pedal, induction-hardened support pins and an ergonomic tool table for quick tool changes.
tubend-hp.headline: 11 – 110 US ton · flat bar to 11-13/16″ × 15/16″ · NC touch-screen with recipes
features: NC control stand with touch-screen: manual mode between set limits, automatic serial modes and recipe mode for multi-step parts
Hydraulic speed and pressure adjustment; ram stroke 7.9″ (HP 10, HP 20) or 11.8″ (HP 40 – HP 100)
Ergonomic tool table at bench height; easy tool change; induction-hardened support pins
Easily adjustable back stop; foot pedal
CSA-approved electrical panel; 600 V 3-phase with transformer (208 / 240 / 480 V on request)
optional: Automatic back gauge — servo-driven NC with pull-back, 3.3, 6.6 or 9.8 ft (1, 2 or 3 m) long, for series parts
Bending tools: Radius punch with v-die, press brake punch with multi-v die, bolt punch with multi-v die, narrow v-die, two-sided v-bending tool, spring-loaded u-bending tool
Pipe and bar tools: mandrel-less pipe bending tool, solid bar and thick-wall pipe bending tool, pipe end reduction and expansion tool, profile bending tool, round bar bending tool, pipe clamping tool
Notching, punching, shearing and straightening tools; busbar shearing, punching, bending and twisting tools
Custom dies made to your part
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase

tubend-hp-heavy.name: HP 120 · HP 150 heavy-duty horizontal presses, 132 – 165 US ton
tubend-hp-heavy.summary: The heavy horizontal presses for straightening and bending big sections: 132 and 165 US tons on a 19.7″ stroke, hardened Ø5-1/8″ and Ø5-7/8″ support columns between which shafts, beams and heavy bar are straightened, a T-slot clamping table with heat-treated support holes for tools and attachments, and an upper brace that keeps the frame from flexing. 19-11/16″ × 1-9/16″ flat bar on the HP 150; NC control stand and foot pedal as on the HP series, and dies designed and made for the job.
tubend-hp-heavy.headline: 132 – 165 US ton · 19.7″ stroke · flat bar to 19-11/16″ × 1-9/16″ · T-slot table
features: NC control unit with control stand and foot pedal; hydraulic speed and pressure adjustment
Hardened support columns, Ø5-1/8″ (HP 120) and Ø5-7/8″ (HP 150), for straightening between columns
Multiple heat-treated support holes for straightening and for mounting tools and attachments
T-slot clamping table for securing tools and dies; upper support brace prevents flexing
Robust steel body; high-profile ergonomic design for large and long workpieces
CSA-approved electrical panel; 600 V 3-phase with transformer (208 / 240 / 480 V on request)
optional: Custom die design and manufacturing for the job
Special requests and revisions on request
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase

tubend-wp.name: WP 100 · WP 300 tilting welding positioners, 220 – 661 lb
tubend-wp.summary: A welding positioner turns the part under the torch, so a round weld is laid in one continuous pass in the flat position instead of being stopped and restarted around the part. Tubend's WP 100 carries 220 lb on a Ø13-3/4″ table that tilts 120°; the WP 300 carries 661 lb on a Ø18-7/8″ table that tilts 90°. The table turns 360° at 1 to 5.5 rpm, set on the control box and run from the standard foot pedal; T-slots take clamps and fixtures, and a Ø6-1/4″ or Ø7-7/8″ lathe chuck or a custom fixture plate (WP 300) is available. Single-phase 220 V.
tubend-wp.headline: 220 – 661 lb · 360° at 1 – 5.5 rpm · 90 – 120° tilt · foot pedal
features: Adjustable tilt angle for easy positioning of the part — 120° (WP 100) or 90° (WP 300), right or left
Adjustable turning speed, 1 – 5.5 rpm, for a steady travel speed under the torch
Standard foot pedal; control box with speed and direction
T-slotted turntable (M10) for clamps and fixtures
optional: Ø6-1/4″ (160 mm) or Ø7-7/8″ (200 mm) 3-jaw lathe chuck
Custom work plate for welding fixtures (WP 300)
tubend-wp.volt_note: Single-phase 220 V supply — no three-phase power needed.

specs.note: Nominal load is a centred part on the horizontal table; with the table tilted the WP 100 carries 110 lb and the WP 300 331 lb. Metric values in brackets are the manufacturer's figures.
